ambiguities.question: Can a failed fixed example refute the whole proposed representation family?
ambiguities.resolution: No. Freeze a fixed-instance prediction and state its boundary; record failures only in that exact scope.

candidates.score_basis: Coordinator ordinal scheduling judgement (1 to 5), not measurements or a novelty verdict. Readiness reflects presence of reusable model controls versus the incidence object still needing definition.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: The six exact design artifacts contain a complete object, inputs, controls, measurable prediction, artifacts and future ownership without unresolved scientific fields.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Preserve incomplete contracts as unapproved, name the exact missing definition/source and rank its minimum repair.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Resolve ordinary prospective choices explicitly; preserve mechanisms and disclose material scope changes.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Every design terminal receipt, snapshot/readback outcome, new ownership record or changed source base.
